policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: AI Futures launch
items.summary: O launched AI Futures (new Strategic Futures blog). Indicates ongoing institutionalization of forward-looking research and thought leadership around AI policy, markets, and timelines.

items.headline: Democratic oversight initiative
items.summary: O announced an initiative to help democratic oversight bodies build expertise and tools to understand and oversee government use of AI for national security.

items.headline: Economic Research Exchange grants
items.summary: O said it is awarding grants to 14 independent projects via the O Economic Research Exchange, following its April 2026 Industrial Policy commitment.

items.headline: Series A $350M
items.summary: G announced it closed a $350M Series A, bringing total recent funding to $1B alongside a previously announced June 2026 round.

items.headline: Neocloud pivot valuation context
items.summary: Credible reporting ties the round to G’s shift from AI chips toward a “neocloud” inference model, framing it as a valuation reset rather than a down round post-licensing.

items.headline: Funding history visibility
items.summary: Secondary financial aggregation sites track the disclosed Series A date/size as the latest funding milestone, useful as corroboration for investors tracking timing/updates.

items.headline: Texas responsible AI letter
items.summary: O published its letter to Governor Abbott on responsible AI infrastructure in Texas, reinforcing engagement with state-level policy and deployment guardrails.
